question: When is World Thyroid Day celebrated every year?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**25 May**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• World Thyroid Day: 25 May.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**World Thyroid Day** is celebrated every year on **25th May**.

 
 
• 
 
It was decided during the **Thyroid Federation International** meeting in **September 2007**.

 
 
• 
 
The first World Thyroid Day was celebrated in **2008**.

 
 
• 
 
The **theme** for this year is **“Thyroid Disease and Artificial Intelligence”**.

 
 
• 
 
The **European Thyroid Association** also started **European Thyroid Day** on **25th May 2008**.
